notes.title: The Silent Column is now $2.99 USD!
notes.notes:
Hi there, everyone!
I've been thinking about what price to sell The Silent Column for, and... I'd like for people to simply be able to buy, play, and enjoy it without its price being an issue. I don't want people to ask "why is this so expensive?" If anything, I'd like them to wonder "why is this so cheap?"

I think lowering the price will help get The Silent Column into the hands of more people who will appreciate it for what it is, whereas a higher price may leave people expecting more and feeling dissatisfied, which is not the goal.

I hope this decision doesn't frustrate any early buyers. I thank them much for their understanding. It was difficult figuring out a price, but I think this is a good one and I don't plan on changing it again.

Thank you again, and I hope you enjoy The Silent Column. :)

notes.title: Price lowered from $11.99 USD to $9.99
notes.notes:
Hi there, everyone! I thought I would announce that the price of The Silent Column has officially been lowered to $9.99!
Originally, The Silent Column was $11.99, and I felt the price was appropriate due to... the time it took to develop the project, the project's word count of 260,000 words, the number of unique art assets in the visual novel, personal bias, recency bias, general inexperience, and trying to account for inflation.
However, after distancing myself from the project for a while, I'm no longer comfortable with that high of a price-point, and have decided to lower it to $9.99. The original price seemed just a bit too high, to me.
I apologize to the early buyers but also thank them for their understanding - it can simply be difficult to set the price of a game properly, the first time, especially when I don't have much experience.
I think this new price is more appropriate and I hope people will enjoy it!
Take care!
